open_items: SBS recovered at cycle 1125 (2026-10-26T22:01Z) after an outage running continuously from cycle 1107 through cycle 1124 (18 cycles, about 34 hours). Still healthy at cycle 1126 (2026-10-27T00:01Z) per the monitor's own check, with fast real responses on all five checks. However this run's live recheck (about 40 minutes after cycle 1126) could not complete a TLS handshake to data-sdmx-disseminate.sbs.gov.ws at all (connection reset by peer), while control requests to ECB and OECD over the same network succeeded, ruling out a network-wide cause on this session's side. Treat SBS as possibly flapping, not cleanly resolved. Next run must re-check live and compare against cycle 1127+ before this is closed out.

ECB flapped healthy -> provider_down -> healthy within a single intermediate cycle at cycle 1121, already resolved and reported as such on the 2026-10-26T18:43Z (cycle 1123) run. No recurrence through cycle 1126. Re-open and alert only if ECB fails again.

Empty-message gateway error pattern ('gateway metadata: Error:' with no text) has been seen on two endpoints: ABS at cycle 26, ECB at cycle 1121, and was also present in SBS's own failure shape during its cycle 1107-1124 outage. Worth a closer look at the gateway's error-reporting path, but not actioned by this read-only routine.

ESTAT gateway metadata latency flap (climbed toward the 60s deadline through cycles 1102-1113, crossed it once at 1113, recovered at 1114): already reported, working as designed. No further climb observed through cycle 1126.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1126: listing served without credentials. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
ILO encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flipped again at this run's /api/contracts read (was/now swap, verdict stays ok). Long-known cosmetic flip, not an incident.

100 claude/ triage branches on origin as of this run's fetch, up from 98 at cycle 1120. Well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine, flagging again so it gets pruned.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); BIS/ILO/IMF references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); ABS/ILO encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict always stays ok.
